meta.title: My Ability Chart
meta.subtitle: See your own progress: self-assess against the HKEAA criteria. No ranking, no comparison with classmates.
meta.disclaimer: For self-review only; this is not an official SBA mark. Official marks are given by your subject teacher according to the HKEAA criteria. AI does not mark your work.
meta.privacy: Data stays on the student's own device / account; the chart never shows any diagnostic label.

scoring.rule: Values come only from the four-level self-assessment the student selects for this criterion in Step 6 "Reflection and Evaluation" (Not yet=1, Basic=2, Good=3, Excellent=4). An unanswered criterion is not plotted (shows "Not rated yet") and is not treated as 0. Checklists, text, photo counts etc. never count toward the value.
scoring.rubric_note: Level descriptors are taken from the teacher guidance of the matching guide step, for reference only. The four levels roughly match HKEAA bands 0–5; official marks follow the HKEAA marking guidelines.

axes.label: Exploration and development of theme or ideas
axes.official_criterion: Exploration and development of theme or ideas

self_field.label: Self-assessment: exploration and development of theme or ideas

levels.label: Not yet
levels.descriptor: Theme is vague or unrelated to the student; materials come from a single source or are irrelevant.

levels.label: Basic
levels.descriptor: A theme and a few keywords; limited sources, and the four-piece plan is incomplete.

levels.label: Good
levels.descriptor: Theme has a personal angle; uses some to a variety of sources, with an early sense of progression across four pieces.

levels.label: Excellent
levels.descriptor: Theme works on personal and social / cultural levels; diverse sources are already being transformed into original ideas, with a clear four-part progression.

related_checklist.note: Related checklist items are prompts only and do not count toward the value.

items.text: The theme has a clear development across four pieces (personal → people around me → society / culture → reflection / way forward, or another logical progression).
There is primary research (own photos, sketches, survey, interview, personal experience) and secondary research (books, news, websites), all acknowledged.

axes.label: Interpretation of artworks and its articulation with artmaking / critical studies
axes.official_criterion: Interpretation of artworks and its articulation with artmaking / critical studies

self_field.label: Self-assessment: interpretation of artworks and articulation with artmaking

levels.label: Not yet
levels.descriptor: Only one or two isolated facts or a copied biography; no personal view.

levels.label: Basic
levels.descriptor: Limited understanding of context or formal qualities; personal view without support; limited application to own work.

levels.label: Good
levels.descriptor: Recognises one or two contexts and some formal qualities; views have some to adequate support; relates the knowledge to own work.

levels.label: Excellent
levels.descriptor: Recognises multiple contexts and formal qualities; informed or insightful views; translates the knowledge into own work.

related_checklist.note: Related checklist items are prompts only and do not count toward the value.

items.text: Artists / artworks from more than one culture are studied, each with a Feldman four-stage analysis and a hands-on "try by myself" study.
The artist statement links every idea to a specific visual element and mentions how reference artists influenced the work.

axes.label: Experimentation of media and skills, and exploration of ways of expression
axes.official_criterion: Experimentation of media and skills, and exploration of ways of expression

self_field.label: Self-assessment: experimentation of media and skills

levels.label: Not yet
levels.descriptor: No tests, or tests unrelated to the theme.

levels.label: Basic
levels.descriptor: Minimal to limited tests; results recorded without reasons or comparison.

levels.label: Good
levels.descriptor: Some to abundant tests, including failures, with reasons for choices.

levels.label: Excellent
levels.descriptor: Abundant, thorough tests that change variables systematically, turn failures into solutions and explore several ways of expression.

related_checklist.note: Related checklist items are prompts only and do not count toward the value.

items.text: Each piece has at least three media / technique tests, including at least one failed or unsatisfactory result.

self_field.label: Self-assessment: reflection and progression in learning

levels.label: Not yet
levels.descriptor: No or rare reflection; no visible progression.

levels.label: Basic
levels.descriptor: Barely reflects; vague content (e.g. "I'm satisfied"); limited progression.

levels.label: Good
levels.descriptor: Occasionally to frequently reflects from some or various perspectives; some to adequate progression.

levels.label: Excellent
levels.descriptor: Continuously and thoroughly reflects from various perspectives with specific evidence; substantial progression across four pieces.

related_checklist.note: Related checklist items are prompts only and do not count toward the value.

items.text: Each finished piece has a reflection and explains how the next piece will improve.

axes.label: Media, skills and techniques / writing skills
axes.official_criterion: Media, skills and techniques / writing skills

self_field.label: Self-assessment: media, skills and techniques / writing skills

levels.label: Not yet
levels.descriptor: Minimal skill; theme not communicated; no process evidence.

levels.label: Basic
levels.descriptor: Limited skill; limited use of visual elements; incomplete communication of theme; little process evidence.

levels.label: Good
levels.descriptor: Average to proficient skill; appropriate to effective use of visual elements; theme clear and complete; adequate process records.

levels.label: Excellent
levels.descriptor: Excellent skill; exceptional use of visual elements and organisation; coherent, complete and innovative communication; thorough process records.

related_checklist.note: Related checklist items are prompts only and do not count toward the value.

items.text: Each piece has at least three media / technique tests, including at least one failed or unsatisfactory result.
The making process has several photos and records "problem → solution".

levels.label: Not yet
levels.descriptor: No sketches or only a final drawing; ideas imitated or unrelated to the theme.

levels.label: Basic
levels.descriptor: One or two options with incomplete ideas; materials used randomly, reasons only "looks good / bad".

levels.label: Good
levels.descriptor: Three options; materials selected and organised; sensible reasons for choices; ideas are satisfactory to personal.

levels.label: Excellent
levels.descriptor: Varied, creative options; research continuously integrated into original ideas; critical choices with clear justification.

related_checklist.note: Related checklist items are prompts only and do not count toward the value.

items.text: Each piece has at least three composition options; rejected ones are marked × with reasons.
3D works have clear photographs; animation / multimedia has a 2D storyboard.
